js: (async () => { const G = window.G, R = G.X.RADIO; if (G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); window.__r0 = R.station; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyU' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'KeyU' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return JSON.stringify({ st0: window.__r0, st: R.station, band: document.getElementById('radioband').style.display, sender: R.sender }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, P = G.player; const ok = c => c && c.userData && !c.userData.bike && !c.userData.heli && !c.userData.cannon && !c.userData.police && !c.userData.ambulance && c.userData.mode !== 'wreck'; let c = G.cars.filter(c => ok(c) && c.userData.mode === 'parked').sort((a, b) => a.position.distanceTo(P.pos) - b.position.distanceTo(P.pos))[0]; if (!c) c = G.cars.filter(c => ok(c) && c.userData.mode === 'ai').sort((a, b) => a.position.distanceTo(P.pos) - b.position.distanceTo(P.pos))[0]; if (!c) return 'kein Auto'; P.pos.set(c.position.x + 0.5, c.position.y, c.position.z); if (P.mesh) P.mesh.position.copy(P.pos); G.toggleCar(); P.wanted = 0; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const u = P.car && P.car.userData; return JSON.stringify({ auto: !!P.car, rad: !!(u && u.bike), mode: c.userData.mode, st: G.X.RADIO.station }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, R = G.X.RADIO; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyU' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'KeyU' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); return JSON.stringify({ st: R.station, text: R.text, spielt: R.playing, audio: R.audioOk, gespeichert: localStorage.getItem('notgta.radio') }); })()
expect: (() => { const R = window.G.X.RADIO, el = document.getElementById('radioband'); return R.station === 0 && R.text.includes(R.sender[0]) && el.style.display === 'block' && el.textContent === R.text && JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notgta.radio')).s === 0; })()
